EngagementSync.title: EngagementSync
EngagementSync.description:
Full engagement as the front end holds it. ``members`` replaces the whole team.

On update, optional fields that are left out keep their current value; send ``null``
to clear one.

effective_date_override.title: Effective Date Override
effective_date_override.description: TEST-ONLY (D4): replaces the rule effective date

JeParamsIn.title: JeParamsIn
JeParamsIn.description: Optional overrides; anything omitted comes from the Rules Library (je.*).

mapping_override.title: Mapping Override
mapping_override.description: {field: column header}. Field names, labels or synonyms are accepted ('posting_date', 'Posting Date', 'date'); {column header: field} also works. "" or null leaves a field unmapped. Unknown names are refused with 422.

SampleOut.title: SampleOut
SampleOut.description: The stored result. Money values are strings with full precision.
